rootPrecedence.technicalGate: Structural digest binding is not requester authorship, human consent, organizational independence, or execution proof.
The envelope and review have authority NONE and cannot grant permissions, authenticate a human, or authorize an executor.
The v2 request, readiness v1, independent assurance v1, and all prior receipt artifacts remain unchanged and passing.
A complete structural binding stops at AUTHENTICATED_HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED outside the Fabric.

closedSeams.result: The envelope binds the SHA-256 digest of the complete normalized v2 request, including provider selection, byte-bound inputs, boundaries, rights, authority ceilings, observation policy, and resource ceilings.
The envelope binds the exact trust-policy identity, schema, and self-digest already verified by independent assurance v1.
The exact policy assurance-schema set and the four roots in governing order are strict, duplicate-free binding fields.
The envelope must be active at route evaluation, remain inside the trust-policy window, and exist no later than every assurance signature it governs.
Every typed hold has an exact monotonic truth stage; even a recomputed digest cannot claim later verification under an earlier status.
The review is order-invariant, strict, self-digesting, independently rebuildable, and fixed at authority NONE.

openSeams.truth: The base v2 schema remains immutable; the additive envelope binds it without pretending the original request contained the new policy field.
No trusted human decision-key policy exists, so the Fabric cannot prove requester authorship or Mike's acceptance.
Cryptographic separation still does not prove distinct organizations, competence, honest measurement, or absence of collusion.
No provider or executor ran, so resource enforcement, private-evidence retention, and output lineage remain unobserved.
